attributes.description: Celestions rarely appear from the void. Their wings emit a strange energy, which absorbs objects that get too close.
Self sufficient and able to produce their own light, Solarions often live in solidarity
A Mangris will confuse its prey with floral appendages. Once it is near, its saw-like front legs strike at the speed of sound.
Sporeleons are often found perched high in the forest canopy, waiting for an unsuspecting meal to pass underneath.
Bazub swarms are both deadly and destructive and can destroy entire croplands in mere minutes
A Bolbon can be inactive for so long that moss, shrubs, or even small trees grow on their backs and limbs.
Nocterra spread halucinogenic pollens which can severely disorient travellers and predators.
Lycospores release clouds of fine particles that shut down the immune systems of other living things.
Floreans root themselves to the ground and become immovable objects. Their vines are stronger than threaded steel, and often it is easier to move the earth itself.
Koranok claws are powerful enough to burrow through permafrost and bedrock, where they build their nests in warm safety.
While swimming at full speed, a Sharakus generates enough energy to cause fifty-meter swells.
Sujin are mischevious tricksters that are able to shape their watery bodies at will to mimic anything they have already seen
Leviathans usually drift throughout the dark abyss, their maws held open like black holes in the sea.
The horns of Seaqueens are coated with a powerful toxin that can potentially paralyze a target or attacker for several days--if they survive the blow.
The Nagae have powerful, muscular bodies that enable them to manoeuvre swiftly and easily through water.
Despite not having bones, each tentacle on a Mermos is capable of crushing a rock to beach sand.
Glacioises move so slowly that they are often mistaken for part of the glaciar.
The wings of an Antarcticus emit a cold wind that cause dense clouds to erupt in snow.
Woovers travel in packs and chase down their prey over extremely long distances, or work together to set ambushes and traps.
Lavekans increase their elemental power when they are on firey ground, and often coil themselves up during combat to amplify that effect
When a Calidus senses a threat, it begins to burn white hot and emits heatwaves that melt swords and char spears to black.
Magmusii ooze a trail of lava wherever they go, which remains hot for many hours before cooling. This makes them easy to track in the wild--and even easier in cities.
Chargoyles usually nest in groups on the sides of volcanoes. Easily startled, their manes erupt with flames in sychronicity as they take wing.
A Firadactus heats the air under its wings to aid its flight, allowing it to soar for many days without rest.
When harmed or threatened, a Ignis emits a strong odor that alerts its hive to the presence of invaders. Soon, there are many buzzing flames and red hot stingers.
If threatened, Blazeos fan out their burning tails to shield themselves from attacks and obscure their image.
When a Phoenix sheds its feathers, the discarded plumage continues to burn until the end of its cycle, even if placed underwater.
A Flamus must always be on the move, lest it melts the ground it stands upon.
Goblens are social creatures that work in large groups. Although small, their voices carry over heat and can extend many miles in the right conditions.
Depedusae cause small earthquakes as they build their complex tunnel networks. They are believed to live at the bottom of the world's crust in perpetual heat, pressure, and darkness.
Whenever something dies near a Darthys, its soul risks being trapped in the crystal on the Darthys' back forever.
The claws of Wraiths are massive and terrifying, but their slash is the legend of stories, which put kids to bed in fear.
Wanderers are said to be powerful warrior spirits that travel the world in desperate search for a worthy opponent.
Baphomets are highly deceptive shapeshifters that commit to their disguises at great lengths, sometimes posing as another being for a full lifetime.
Because they have no desires of their own, Sentinels stand guard at attention indefinitely. They are the perfect soldiers.
The glowing gold antlers of Elkari are used for mating rituals and courtship combat. Elkari are sometimes found to be training against large boulders and can turn a mountainside to rubble.
Highly sensitive to the world and its vibrations, Lumeniciae communicate through photons of light.
Gryphons whip their tails to send shockwaves of air that stun and shatter with sound on impact.
Pegasusies gallop through the night sky, wherefore they are commonly mistaken for falling stars.
Templars have powerful wings that allow for sudden take-off and blurring flight. They cannot be caught--only trapped and befriended.
The Undead Corruption is unleashed into the world which taints souls and turns them into hivemind zombies
attributes.agenda: To spread the corruption and create the abyssal horde and control all chaos in creation
attributes.locations: presence through channelling or spread around the world, greater presence in corrupted sites

attributes.description: The Dark Brotherhood is a group of assassins and thieves who seek to control the world from the shadows
attributes.agenda: To gain power and control over the world
attributes.locations: presence in every major city and scattered presence anywhere in the world

1800d91a-fdda-45e0-a5da-a4d0ce0a41b5.name: The Cult of the silent night

attributes.description: The Cult of the Undead is a group of fanatics who worship the Undead Corruption and seek to spread it throughout the world
attributes.agenda: To spread the Undead Corruption and gain power

attributes.description: an aging monarch desperate to maintain its hold on power
attributes.agenda: to recover its lost lands and return to its former glory, to conquer the entire world
attributes.locations: controls smaller kingdoms and satellite states

attributes.description: technological scientific people pushing for superiority, creating conflict in ethics and fighting for resources to fuel their hungry tech
attributes.agenda: maintaining their prosperity and independence, bringing freedom to more people
attributes.locations:
Star Co' the company secretly owned by the empire, deals in several major situations
- provides aid and sells medicine to water kingdom
- creates and sells weapons

attributes.description: minimalist fighter monks
detached from the land they are convinced to destroy the lands they are in for wealth, they turn against the others to get their way
attributes.agenda: control of the region, wealth and power

attributes.description: traditional people living spiritual lives on the plains, they feel a responsibility to the ecosystem and try to avoid actions that can cause harm
attributes.agenda: maintaining their prosperity and independence, living harmoniously with the land

attributes.description: politically agnostic order of elite warriors from around the world sworn to the protection of the realm against major threats
attributes.agenda: to maintain control and ensure there is no political threat while maintaining diplomacy to request resources, with at least an ambassador from representing each nation in the order

attributes.description: a religious group of priest monks who travel the world compiling knowledge and running various services
attributes.agenda:
some people have been hijacked in by the order, theyve added their own information to the main directives

theyve taken some of the directives and layered on extra commandments that are a bit more sectarian, being used to reinforce divisions

attributes.description: The Order of the Light is a group of fanatical warrior knights who are sworn to protect the realm until the return of the prophet
attributes.agenda: To protect the world from darkness and chaos
attributes.locations: base in main city, scattered presence in many locations

attributes.description: global trade management
attributes.agenda: try to maintain global trade management and funnels money to capital

attributes.description: bit darker, usually involved in nefarious things, controlled by crime gang(dark brotherhood)

attributes.agenda: when someone becomes a legend of the realm, theyre honored on the pantheon

attributes.description: Jax
attributes.subplot: A hatchling with a rebellious streak who befriends Lulu and joins her quest
attributes.agenda: Jax becomes Lulu's closest ally and supporter, willing to help her achieve her goals at any cost

attributes.description: General Torm
attributes.subplot: The leader of the Royal Hatchling Army who opposes Lulu and her friends
attributes.agenda: Torm sees Lulu's group as a threat to the established order and is determined to stop them at all costs

attributes.description: Professor Wren
attributes.subplot: A wise and eccentric scientist who helps Lulu and her friends on their quest
attributes.agenda: Wren sees the value in Lulu's mission and is determined to aid her in any way possible

attributes.description: The Enforcers
attributes.subplot: A group of powerful hatchlings tasked with maintaining order and enforcing the law
attributes.agenda: The Enforcers initially see Lulu's group as a threat, but they eventually come to realize the importance of their mission

attributes.description: Queen Vespera
attributes.subplot: The powerful and mysterious queen of the hatchling world
attributes.agenda: Vespera is initially a looming presence in the background, but as the series progresses, her true motivations are revealed

attributes.description: The Wise Mentor
attributes.subplot: Provides guidance and advice to the protagonist
attributes.agenda: To help the protagonist fulfill their destiny and become a hero

attributes.description: The Rival
attributes.subplot: Competes with the protagonist for a common goal
attributes.agenda: To prove themselves better than the protagonist

attributes.description: The Traitor
attributes.subplot: Betrays the protagonist or their allies
attributes.agenda: To gain power or to further their own goals

attributes.description: The Antihero
attributes.subplot: Resembles a hero but lacks traditional heroic qualities
attributes.agenda: To achieve their own goals, which may conflict with the greater good

attributes.description: The Love Interest
attributes.subplot: Provides a romantic subplot for the protagonist
attributes.agenda: To pursue or be pursued by the protagonist

attributes.description: The Mad Scientist
attributes.subplot: Pursues scientific knowledge and advancement regardless of the consequences
attributes.agenda: To unlock the secrets of the universe, often at the expense of others

attributes.description: The Religious Fanatic
attributes.subplot: Devotes themselves completely to a religion or ideology
attributes.agenda: To spread their beliefs and achieve salvation

attributes.description: The Corrupt Politician
attributes.subplot: Abuses their power for personal gain
attributes.agenda: To maintain their position and increase their wealth and influence

attributes.description: The Vigilante
attributes.subplot: Takes justice into their own hands
attributes.agenda: To right wrongs and punish criminals

attributes.description: The Rebel Leader
attributes.subplot: Fights against a tyrannical regime
attributes.agenda: To overthrow the regime and establish a new order

attributes.description: The Immortal Being
attributes.subplot: Possesses eternal life and immense power
attributes.agenda: To maintain their existence and exert their will on the world

attributes.description: The Wise Old Mentor
attributes.subplot: A mentor figure who imparts important knowledge and guidance to the protagonist

attributes.description: The Trickster
attributes.subplot: A mischievous and unpredictable character who often acts as a foil to the protagonist

attributes.description: The Femme Fatale
attributes.subplot: A seductive and dangerous woman who uses her charms to manipulate others

attributes.description: The Beast
attributes.subplot: A powerful and dangerous creature that is often a symbol of primal nature

attributes.description: The Prophet
attributes.subplot: A visionary or religious figure who provides insight into the future or spiritual realm

attributes.description: The Outsider
attributes.subplot: A character who is an outsider to the society they find themselves in, often bringing an outside perspective and disrupting the status quo

attributes.description: The Anti-Hero
attributes.subplot: A protagonist who lacks traditional heroic qualities and often engages in morally ambiguous behavior

attributes.description: Azura, Queen of the Sky
attributes.subplot: Ruler of the Sky Kingdom, ally to the Light
attributes.agenda: Protect her people and maintain power

attributes.description: Thorne, Leader of the Rebellion
attributes.subplot: Leader of the Resistance against the Dark Empire
attributes.agenda: Overthrow the Dark Empire and establish democracy

762243f0-b213-48a9-bbe3-b07abd8cf68b.name: Xiulan, High Priestess of the Temple of Balance

attributes.description: Xiulan, High Priestess of the Temple of Balance
attributes.subplot: Spiritual leader of the world, mediator between Light and Dark
attributes.agenda: Restore balance to the world, prevent the Chaos God from being unleashed

e89cac73-d9a2-4e93-87ca-0a183476563a.name: Maelstrom, Admiral of the Undead Fleet

attributes.description: Maelstrom, Admiral of the Undead Fleet
attributes.subplot: Commander of the Undead Fleet, serves the Chaos God
attributes.agenda: Unleash the Chaos God and spread undead corruption throughout the world

attributes.description: Helena
attributes.subplot: A high-ranking member of the Order, Helena is committed to the pursuit of order and control, even if it means sacrificing personal freedoms. She is a staunch advocate for the Order's methods, and is willing to go to great lengths to ensure their goals are met.

attributes.description: Zephyr
attributes.subplot: A skilled warrior and leader of the Wind Clan, Zephyr is fiercely independent and values personal freedom above all else. He is a thorn in the side of both the Order and the Dominion, and is often caught in the middle of their conflicts.

attributes.description: Aria
attributes.subplot: A powerful healer and diplomat, Aria is dedicated to the pursuit of unity and cooperation between the different nations and factions. She is often called upon to mediate disputes and broker peace between warring parties.

attributes.description: Viktor
attributes.subplot: A ruthless general in the Dominion's army, Viktor is driven by a desire for power and control. He sees democracy as a weakness, and views the Dominion's rule as the only way to maintain order and stability in the world.

attributes.description: Vesper
attributes.subplot: A mysterious and enigmatic figure, Vesper is the leader of the Moon Clan and has a deep connection to the powers of darkness. Her motivations are often unclear, and she is a wildcard in the ongoing conflicts between the different factions.

attributes.description: Kalen
attributes.subplot: A powerful and ambitious firebender, Kalen is determined to prove herself as a worthy successor to the throne. She is fiercely loyal to her nation, but also recognizes the need for cooperation and unity in the face of external threats.

attributes.description: Arin
attributes.subplot: A skilled earthbender and member of the royal family, Arin is torn between her duty to her nation and her desire for personal freedom. She struggles to balance her responsibilities as a leader with her own ambitions and desires.

attributes.description: Thorne
attributes.subplot: A master assassin and leader of the Shadow Guild, Thorne operates in the shadows and is feared by many. He has his own agenda and motivations, but is often willing to work with others if it serves his interests.

attributes.description: Lucius
attributes.subplot: Discovers the world of hatchy and becomes a summoner
attributes.nation: Protagonist, becomes central to the fight against the Crystalists
attributes.agenda: To learn about hatchy and become a strong summoner, to protect his loved ones and the world from the Crystalists

attributes.description: Elena
attributes.subplot: Specializes in spirit binding and helps Lucius navigate the dangerous world of summoning
attributes.agenda: To restore the power of the omni and protect the world from the Crystalists

attributes.description: Kael
attributes.subplot: Skilled tamer who joins Lucius on his quest
attributes.agenda: To help Lucius restore the power of the omni and protect the world from the Crystalists

attributes.description: Saria
attributes.subplot: Card summoner who initially opposes Lucius and his mission, but eventually becomes an ally
attributes.agenda: To pursue her own agenda and fight for her family's interests

attributes.description: Alazar
attributes.subplot: Ancient hatchy who holds the key to unlocking the full power of the omni
attributes.agenda: To assist Lucius and the hatchy in their fight against the Crystalists

attributes.description: Baphomet
attributes.subplot: Dark monster who haunts Lucius and threatens to consume him
attributes.agenda: To use Lucius to help the Crystalists achieve their goals

attributes.description: Grendel
attributes.subplot: Powerful summoner who has a history with Lucius' family
attributes.nation: Secondary protagonist, helps Lucius on his journey
attributes.agenda: To protect the world from the Crystalists and help Lucius become a strong summoner

attributes.description: Aria
attributes.subplot: Hatchy companion to Grendel, also has a history with Lucius' family
attributes.nation: Helps Grendel and Lucius on their journey
attributes.agenda: To protect the world from the Crystalists and restore the power of the omni

attributes.description: Crystalists
attributes.subplot: Group of humans who seek to use crystals for destruction
attributes.nation: Antagonists, seek to control the world
attributes.agenda: To gain power and control over the world

attributes.description: Elemental spirits
attributes.subplot: Guardians of the world's elemental power
attributes.nation: Guides and helps the main characters on their journey
attributes.agenda: To restore the power of the omni and protect the world from the Crystalists

attributes.description: A wealthy coastal nation known for its strong navy and mercantile trade.
attributes.conflict: The ruling aristocracy is fiercely opposed by a populist movement seeking to expand voting rights and democratize the government.

attributes.description: a small farming kingdom, once arid, turned into an oasis with the help of the hatchies and now the foodbowl of the region
attributes.conflict: with added value comes added conflict, the other kingdoms are fighting to take the land for their advantage, shifting delegates vote to absorb them to the larger kingdom

attributes.description: a democratic nation that seeks to promote freedom and democracy throughout the world
attributes.conflict: The Dominion of Arcadia is a highly advanced society, where technology and magic are used in harmony to improve people's lives. However, a powerful corporation has gained too much control over the government, and are using their resources to conduct dangerous experiments in genetics, robotics and advanced weapons

attributes.description: The Kingdom of Azura is a powerful and prosperous nation that seeks to maintain its dominance over other nations
attributes.conflict: To maintain its power and control over other nations, controller of the trade routes, owners of the colloseum and hosts of events

attributes.description: scattered ancient race, some oral tradition and history preserved by elders
attributes.themes: wartorn remnants of a once great empire
attributes.conflict: mostly tribal nomadic peoples, scattered around the plains and the pirate nation ports

attributes.description:
rough port town location full of rogue gypsy like pirates

some of the inhabitants are scattered remnants of the ancient peoples, with some small stories managing to survive amongst the elders who somehow can still maintain some order in and around the chaotic ports and tribalistic pirates
attributes.conflict: barely loyalty to anyone, the pirates are known to even fight amongst themselves for power or loot

The Confederacy of Thorn is made up of several tribes of druidic summoners, who live in harmony with nature and the spirits of their ancestors. However, a group of extremist summoners believe that the spirits are not doing enough to protect their people, and have started experimenting with the corruption to gain more power.

attributes.description: A harsh, desert land ruled by a powerful warlord who has united many warring tribes under his banner.
attributes.conflict: The warlord's brutal tactics and demands for tribute have sparked a rebellion among some of the tribes, who seek to overthrow his rule and establish their own independence.

The Republic of Ironclad has long been a major exporter of iron and steel, but a recent discovery of a rare mineral in their territory has led to tensions with neighboring nations. The government is willing to do whatever it takes to protect their interests, including making deals with dark entities.
Two powerful mage families feud over control of a valuable magical artifact
A rebellion seeks to overthrow the corrupt monarchy
The central government attempts to assert control over various regional governments

attributes.description: A frozen tundra populated by hardy, isolated communities that have developed their own distinct cultures and traditions.
attributes.conflict: A new railroad project linking Norlund to other parts of the continent has sparked a wave of immigration and economic development, but has also threatened the traditional ways of life and autonomy of the local communities.
The royal family is divided over the throne succession, leading to a civil war

attributes.description: A highly centralized monarchy with a strong tradition of magic and scholarship.
attributes.conflict: The queen's ambitious reform program has sparked widespread resentment among the nobility and the conservative clergy, who fear that their privileges and influence are under threat.
A religious sect gains political power and begins imposing their beliefs on the rest of the nation

attributes.themes: taken under eziria, fighting for independence
attributes.conflict: A separatist movement seeks independence from the central government(eziria)
The ruling class hoards resources while the lower classes suffer from poverty and disease, causing a group of revolutionaries to rise up against them

attributes.description: A vast, rugged frontier region with a diverse population of humans, dwarves, and elves.
attributes.conflict: The kingdom's resources are being rapidly depleted by a mining boom that has attracted large numbers of outsiders, sparking conflict with indigenous communities and straining the government's ability to maintain order.

The queen of Arktos is obsessed with finding a way to bring back her deceased husband, and has hired a team of rogue summoners to help her. However, her actions are causing a rift between her and her people, who believe that death should be respected.

attributes.description: corrupted lands
attributes.conflict: The ruling class of nobles practice forbidden alchemy and necromancy seeking to expand their influence and territory
